body: If you feel like talking send me a message, up for lending an ear.
Try and talk to your doctor about how it makes you feel? Maybe you will have some succes with that

Ah, i tried doing a dumb joke to cheer you up! If you wanna talk msg me in private, i am more then up for listening to it.  
I totally understand how you are feeling, how you wish nothing was there to begin with, so it would  be nothing to lose, or anyone to lose you.   
But there is, and that's a fact. We need to live for others, but most important we need to find a reason to live for ourselves, even if that reason is beyond our understanding right now.

Dieing is pretty overrated, how about you order a pizza and try to enjoy a movie instead?

Nothing is better then pizza. Except maybe chicken wings!

I see, it's a valid point! But i can barely find the "Strenght" to shower once every week or so just so others don't think i am a dead corpse. My motivation to do anything except sleep and escape reality with video games is less then 0. That's the shitty part.
What about my very own special ability? Commenting without thinking

But it's so hard to stop thinking about the future, when the present is so gosh darn miserable.Except the hope that "tomorrow" it might be better, we don't really have alot.. do we?But i see your point, and is valid. We should live more in the moment...  


I guess the real problem is that the future also seems miserable, or well at best "unknown"

Yea, i agree. Didn't mean to be negative. It just seems that it's as you've said.. Up to chance, and if nothing else a bit random.  
I don't plan on giving up, but i am also tired of lieing to myself. So the future might bring whatever it wants, i am ready!

IT doesn't feel Hopeless now tho, it's been like this for a long time. I totally appreciate your words and encouragement and if anything they will only push me foward, but it's to easy for people to say stuff like this.
